table.name: singer
table.purpose: One row per person identified as a 'singer', with birth year, citizenship, and net worth. However, the Name values are famous billionaires (Waltons, Rinehart, Klatten, Fontbona, Mars, Johnson), not singers, so the table's true subject is likely wealthy individuals; the 'singer' label is not supported by the data. Each row is referenced by songs in the song table via Singer_ID.

Citizenship.name: Citizenship
Citizenship.description: Country of citizenship of the person (e.g. United States, Australia, Chile, France, Germany).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the person. Note: despite the table name 'singer', the values (Christy Walton, Alice Walton, Iris Fontbona, Gina Rinehart, Susanne Klatten, etc.) are names of well-known billionaires/heirs, not singers — the table name appears misleading.

Net_Worth_Millions.name: Net_Worth_Millions
Net_Worth_Millions.description: Net worth of the person, 12.7–30.0. Declared unit is millions, but the named individuals are billionaires, so the values plausibly represent billions of USD; the column name's unit is questionable. Unit unresolved between millions and billions.

Singer_ID.name: Singer_ID
Singer_ID.description: Primary key of the table; unique identifier for each person (row). Referenced by song.Singer_ID (and statistically by song.Highest_Position, though that join is likely spurious).

table.name: song
table.purpose: One row per song, recording its title, performing singer (FK to singer), peak chart position, and total sales.

Highest_Position.name: Highest_Position
Highest_Position.description: Peak chart position reached by the song (1 = number one); values 1 and 3 observed, so likely UK singles chart peak position.

Sales.name: Sales
Sales.description: Total sales/units sold of the song (e.g., 1,094,000 for a #1 hit); raw count, not currency.

Singer_ID.name: Singer_ID
Singer_ID.description: Foreign key to singer.Singer_ID identifying the performing artist of the song.

Song_ID.name: Song_ID
Song_ID.description: Primary key of the song table; unique identifier for each song.
